note: Visible tests cover lower-casing, runs of punctuation and hyphens at the ends; only the hidden tests cover apostrophes, underscores, letters and digits outside ASCII, a title with nothing to keep and the type check.

twin_breaks.rule: Any other letter or digit, such as `é`, `ß` or `²`, counts as one of the other characters
Only the ASCII letters and digits of rule 1 are kept.
